description: Named person, date, scope, artifact reference. Two variants, same acceptance discipline: 'fit-to-standard' (produced by fit-to-standard, checked by explore→realize) and 'deploy-go-live' (produced by cutover-plan/go-live-readiness, checked by deploy→run). The 'variant' field picks which of the two variant-specific field groups below is required.

session_status.description: 'live' = an actual session happened, this record is an acceptance. 'draft-pending-facilitation' = prepared or simulated ahead of/without a real session — a preview, not an acceptance. Only 'live' records satisfy the validity checklist or count toward a Q-gate.

process_scope.description: Human-readable label for the scope (process name/variant, or process areas covered at go-live) — not an independent scope definition; the variant-specific reference field below wins if they disagree.

signed_by.description: Full name and title of the signer. Distinct from any per-item owner (decision log Delta owner, or checklist item owner), even when it's the same person.

role_authority.description: Why this person can accept — e.g. 'Process Owner, Order to Cash' or 'Delivery Manager, go-live authority'.

decision_log_row_id_range.description: Required when variant=fit-to-standard. Row ID range from the fit-to-standard decision log, e.g. FTS-2026-08-04-credit-block-handling-row-01..07. Source of truth for scope; wins over process_scope if they ever disagree.

deltas_accepted.description: Required when variant=fit-to-standard. Row IDs accepted in this scope.

deltas_rejected.description: Required when variant=fit-to-standard. Row IDs where standard was adopted instead of the proposed delta. An empty array on a large process is a signal to re-check whether pushback actually happened.

go_live_checklist_reference.description: Required when variant=deploy-go-live. Which go-live-readiness checklist run this sign-off closes — process areas covered, checklist date. Source of truth for scope; wins over process_scope if they ever disagree.

checklist_items_closed.description: Required when variant=deploy-go-live. Checklist items confirmed closed.

checklist_items_open_with_risk_acceptanc.description: Required when variant=deploy-go-live. Every item still open at go-live, each with a named person who accepted the risk — an unacknowledged open item is not neutral.

cutover_rehearsal_reference.description: Used when variant=deploy-go-live. The cutover-plan dress-rehearsal run this sign-off also covers.

open_items_deferred.description: Open questions moved to the backlog rather than left unresolved in this record.

superseded_records.description: Prior sign-off-record references this one replaces for the same scope, if any.
